tagline.en: Dallas to the Gulf, on the first freeway Texas ever built
tagline.zh: 从达拉斯直抵墨西哥湾，起于得州第一条高速

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 得克萨斯州达拉斯市中心，与 I-30 相接

end.zh: 得克萨斯州加尔维斯顿

en: I-45 lies entirely within Texas, running from downtown Dallas south through the pine country of east-central Texas to Houston, then on across the bay causeway to Galveston. It replaced US 75 along that line and is the state's main inland connection between its largest metropolitan area and the Gulf.

The middle is the emptiest part: a long, fast, largely straight run past Corsicana, Fairfield and Huntsville, with small towns set back from the road and few reasons to stop. The two ends are the opposite. In Houston the route is one of the most heavily rebuilt urban corridors in the country, and at the southern tip it crosses open water on a causeway before arriving on a barrier island.

It also carries more history than its number suggests. The Houston–Galveston leg, the Gulf Freeway, was the first freeway built anywhere in Texas, and it set the template — continuous frontage roads on both sides — that Texas has used on urban freeways ever since.
zh: I-45 全程位于得克萨斯州境内，自达拉斯市中心南下，穿过得州中东部的松林地带抵达休斯敦，再经跨海堤道通往加尔维斯顿。它取代了这条线上的 US 75，是该州最大都会区与墨西哥湾之间的主要内陆通道。
中段最为空旷：经科西卡纳、费尔菲尔德和亨茨维尔的一长段快速而基本笔直的路，小镇都远离公路，也少有停下来的理由。两端则截然相反。在休斯敦，这条路线是全美改建最频繁的城市走廊之一；在最南端，它经堤道跨过开阔水面，抵达一座堰洲岛。
它承载的历史也比编号显示的更多。休斯敦至加尔维斯顿一段——「海湾快速路」——是得克萨斯境内最早建成的高速公路，它确立了两侧连续设置辅路的范式，得州此后的城市高速公路一直沿用至今。

en: The first contracts for the Gulf Freeway were awarded in September 1946, and the first section, from downtown Houston out to Telephone Road, opened on the evening of 30 September 1948 with a ceremony on the Calhoun Road overpass. The road had no name at the time; the press called it the Interurban Expressway, after the electric railway whose right-of-way it had taken, and the city ran a naming contest that produced 'Gulf Freeway' that December.

Extensions followed in 1951, and a ceremony on 2 August 1952 marked completion to the Galveston Causeway — though for most of its length beyond the city the road still had dozens of at-grade intersections and was not a freeway in any strict sense. Upgrading it took another two decades.

The Dallas–Houston half came together later. The last freeway link between the two cities, between Fairfield and Streetman, opened in October 1971, and the stretch from I-20 into downtown Dallas was finished in 1975. The final upgrade of the southern end to full freeway standard came in 1976.
zh: 海湾快速路的首批合同于 1946 年 9 月发出，第一段——自休斯敦市中心至电话路——于 1948 年 9 月 30 日傍晚通车，在卡尔霍恩路跨线桥上举行了仪式。当时这条路还没有名字；媒体沿用它所占用路权的那条电气化铁路，称它为「城际快速路」，市政府随后举办命名征集，当年 12 月定名为「海湾快速路」。
1951 年又有延伸段通车，1952 年 8 月 2 日的仪式标志着道路修到了加尔维斯顿堤道——尽管出城以后的大部分路段仍有数十处平面交叉，严格意义上算不上高速公路。把它升级过来又花了二十年。
达拉斯至休斯敦的那一半成型更晚。两城之间最后一段高速公路——费尔菲尔德至斯特里特曼——于 1971 年 10 月通车，自 I-20 进入达拉斯市中心的路段 1975 年建成。南端升级至完整高速公路标准则在 1976 年完成。

en: The expensive part of I-45 today is not building it but rebuilding it. The North Houston Highway Improvement Project reroutes the Interstate around the downtown loop, depresses part of the adjoining I-69, adds managed express lanes, and takes the elevated Pierce Elevated out of service entirely.

The project is divided into three segments with separate budgets and separate schedules, and its estimate has risen sharply since the environmental process concluded. TxDOT's own segment documentation carries the current figures; the department has attributed the increase to inflation, litigation and delay.

For the original construction there is no comparable record. The Gulf Freeway and the Dallas approaches were built by the state before the Interstate programme existed, and the rural link between the two cities was built with federal aid accounted for by year rather than by route.
zh: 今天 I-45 上花钱的地方不是修建，而是重建。「休斯敦北部公路改善工程」把这条州际公路改道绕行市中心环路，将相邻的 I-69 部分路段下压，增设管理型快速车道，并让「皮尔斯高架」彻底退出使用。
该工程分为三个标段，各有预算、各有工期，其造价估算自环境审批程序结束以来大幅上升。得州交通部自己的标段文件给出了当前数字；该部门把上涨归因于通货膨胀、诉讼与工期延误。
最初的建设则没有可与之相比的记录。海湾快速路与达拉斯的进城路段是在州际公路计划出现之前由州里修建的，两城之间的乡村连接段所用的联邦补助资金则按年度而非按路线核算。

why.en: No public figure exists. The Houston and Dallas ends were built by the state as the Gulf Freeway and Central Expressway before the Interstate programme began, and the rest was built with federal aid accounted for by fiscal year rather than by route.
why.zh: 无公开数据。休斯敦端与达拉斯端是在州际公路计划启动之前，由州里作为「海湾快速路」与「中央快速路」修建的；其余部分使用的联邦补助资金按财政年度而非按路线核算。

value.en: 285.03 miles, all of it in Texas
value.zh: 285.03 英里，全部位于得克萨斯州

label.zh: 休斯敦北部公路改善工程第 3 标段

value.zh: 市中心环路系统 6,514,955,000 美元，分九份施工合同发包

figures.source: Texas Department of Transportation, I-45 NHHIP Segment 3 general update, October 2025

label.en: North Houston Highway Improvement Project, Segment 1
label.zh: 休斯敦北部公路改善工程第 1 标段

value.en: $1.15 billion estimated for I-45 from I-610 to Beltway 8, unfunded and not expected to start before 2032
value.zh: I-45 自 I-610 至 8 号环路段估算 11.5 亿美元，尚无资金来源，预计 2032 年前不会开工

figures.source: Texas Department of Transportation, NHHIP Segment 1 project page

value.en: About $13 billion, against an initial TxDOT estimate of roughly $7 billion
value.zh: 约 130 亿美元，而得州交通部最初的估算约为 70 亿美元

figures.source: Spectrum News, quoting a TxDOT public involvement liaison, 8 June 2026

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. TxDOT counts traffic by segment, and volumes on this route span from the downtown Houston loop, among the busiest road sections in the state, to rural stretches in Freestone and Leon counties.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。得州交通部按路段统计交通量，本路线的流量从全州最繁忙路段之一的休斯敦市中心环路，到弗里斯通县和利昂县的乡村路段，差异极大。

timeline.en: The first section of the Gulf Freeway opens on 30 September between downtown Houston and Telephone Road — the first freeway built in Texas.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，海湾快速路首段在休斯敦市中心至电话路之间通车，是得克萨斯州最早建成的高速公路。

timeline.en: A ceremony on 2 August marks completion to the Galveston Causeway, though much of the southern half still has at-grade intersections.
timeline.zh: 8 月 2 日的仪式标志道路修至加尔维斯顿堤道，但南半段大部分仍有平面交叉。

timeline.en: The Pierce Elevated is completed, carrying the route around the west and south sides of downtown Houston.
timeline.zh: 皮尔斯高架建成，将本路线引至休斯敦市中心的西侧与南侧。

timeline.en: The Fairfield–Streetman link opens on 13 October, the last freeway gap between Houston and Dallas.
timeline.zh: 10 月 13 日费尔菲尔德至斯特里特曼段通车，这是休斯敦与达拉斯之间最后一处高速公路缺口。

timeline.en: The southern end is brought up to freeway standard, completing I-45 in Texas.
timeline.zh: 南端升级至高速公路标准，I-45 在得克萨斯州全线完成。

timeline.en: Construction begins on the downtown Houston segments that will reroute I-45 and retire the Pierce Elevated.
timeline.zh: 休斯敦市中心各标段开工，将把 I-45 改道，并让皮尔斯高架退役。
